gmm.support: very strong support for two groups
gmm.verdict: ΔBIC = +23.2 (one group 12539.7, two groups 12516.5): very strong support for two groups. BIC compares Gaussian shapes, and a single skewed cloud can earn two components, so this is evidence, not proof. Its two groups match the DS / P-spike call closely (adjusted Rand 0.65, 90% of events the same), so this reads as two kinds of event.

dbic_scale: very strong support for two groups

measure.filter_label: DS filter, 5–100 Hz, 60 Hz mains out

rule: Pooled over 9 recordings from 9 mice, in pooled raw units: the cluster whose centre has more 500–1000 Hz power is called P-spike: +13.7 dB against +8.4 dB for the other, which is called DS (831 DS, 644 P-spike, 2 not measured; 6 resolved only with a half-width search widened past 50 ms).

scale.why: Pooled raw units, z-scored once across the pool: differences in size between mice stay visible, impedance and placement included.

split_axis.unit: z, 0 at the midpoint, DS negative
